title: Why 96% Of Kelp Vanished After Sea Stars Collapsed
hook: California lost 96% of kelp after its key predator disappeared.
closing: Kelp protects entire food webs, so losing one predator can reshape a coast.
question: Can one predator save a forest?

segments.say: Sunflower sea stars fell 99%, removing the predator that kept kelp-eating urchins in check.
Purple urchins surged 101 times, so grazing pressure exploded after their main predator vanished.
Kelp canopy fell 96%, stripping away habitat that supports the North Coast food web.
